sloka: तान् दृष्ट्वा सप्त निर्भिन्नान् सालान् वानरपुंगवः ।रामस्य शर वेगेन विस्मयम् परमम् गतः ॥४-१२-५॥
transliteration: tān dṛṣṭvā sapta nirbhinnān sālān vānarapuṁgavaḥ ।rāmasya śara vegena vismayam paramam gataḥ ॥4-12-5॥

translations.english: The chief of the monkeys was struck with wonder seeing Rama's arrow piercing through the seven sala trees so swiftly.
